requirements.description: The user explicitly requires at least 600 sqm of gross floor area, so surface_area is filtered with >= 600. The 45-person capacity is not converted into an area filter, since no verified gross-area threshold was supplied by the RegulatoryAgent. Energy class, proximity to green spaces, and the Turin location are outside REFERENCE COLUMNS and are handled by other agents.
The user prefers a property near green spaces. Proximity expressed as a preference, so the threshold is set at the 75th percentile of the green distribution (74.26, rounded to 74).
Energy class D or better, as explicitly requested by the user.

output.explanation: Applies the four extracted requirements: surface_area >= 600; a 3.0 km haversine radius around (45.0677551, 7.6824892); energy_class in A1–D; and green >= 74. Results are ordered by distance from the coordinate. No property-type filter was added because the extracted requirements do not include one.
